verdict.rationale: Termius is presented as a cloud-synced SSH client with Personal/Team vaults and sync services (termius-docs-8, termius-docs-9, termius-docs-29); there is no mention of any self-hosted server/backend option or on-prem deployment for the core product. termius-docs-15 only notes local caching of credentials for offline connect, not a self-hosted core service. Missing for 10: any documented self-hosted/on-prem deployment option, self-hosting instructions, or enterprise self-managed sync server.
